title: Add visible Log In option and fix wallet/balance display

requirements.text: Add a clearly visible Log In option for unauthenticated users in the global header, using Internet Identity authentication (same auth mechanism as current Sign Up flow), and ensure the primary call-to-action reads "Log In" (English) when the user is not authenticated.

quotes: Ap na yaha log in k oppotion nii dia or wallet show nii ho raha

acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, the header shows a visible button labeled "Log In" (English).
Clicking "Log In" initiates (or routes to a screen that initiates) Internet Identity login and returns the user to the app authenticated.
When the user is authenticated, the header does not show "Log In" and instead shows the authenticated-state navigation (e.g., Profile).

requirements.text: Ensure the wallet/balance UI is visible and correctly populated after login by making balance loading/empty/error states explicit in the UI, and by providing a clear sign-in prompt when the user is not authenticated (instead of silently hiding the wallet indicator).
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is authenticated, the wallet/balance indicator renders and shows either a loading state or a numeric balance value (not blank).
When the user is not authenticated, the UI shows an English sign-in prompt for wallet/balance access (rather than the wallet area appearing missing).
If balance fetching fails, the user sees an English error message and a retry/refresh control that re-attempts the balance query.

requirements.text: Fix backend authorization initialization so that authenticated users can call onboarding and wallet/balance methods without hitting the "Authorization system not ready" trap, and ensure initialization/admin recognition is not lost across canister upgrades.
acceptanceCriteria: After deployment/upgrade, authenticated users can successfully call onboarding() and getBalance() without receiving "Authorization system not ready, reload and try again".
Admin-only methods (e.g., getAdminWalletBalance, adminDistributeFunds, adminTopUp) work for principals with admin permissions after redeployments/upgrades.
If initialization is required, it occurs automatically (no manual steps) before any user-facing flow depends on it.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; introduce backend/migration.mo changes only if state upgrade is required by the fix.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
All user-facing text introduced/modified by this change must be in English.
nonGoals: Add any non-Internet-Identity authentication provider (e.g., Google, Facebook, Auth0).
Integrate external wallets or web3 wallet providers (e.g., MetaMask, WalletConnect).
Add external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
